reviews.text: I went to this shop today to buy a dog's ball toy for my elderly neighbour. I never had dog so the lady at the cashier helped me to pick the right ones for the dog. Absolutely great customer service and decent pricing. I thank you very much for the help. I would recommend this shop Absolutely amazing.
Ginger and I could literally buy everything in this shop. Jackie saw to us she was friendly and informative we will definitely be returning loads of choice everything looks really good quality.

Truly lovely independent store! Very helpful and knowledgeable owner, amazing range!
Go here to buy all you need for your cat, dog etc. Amazon etc kills these brilliant local shops, so do!
A lovely pet store for cats and dogs. We stopped by and was able to sample some treats before deciding which to get.

A treat to have a real shop and very well stocked. Thanks a million to your member of staff that was super generous with time and advice. Never felt pushed to make a purchase, just fantastic. Thank you
Popped in for eye wipes for me dog because we forgot to bring some on a weekend away

I went to this shop to get all thats needed for a rescue dog. The lady in the shop was amazing, my wife and myself clearly didn't really know what we wanted, there was no pushing only gentle advice. Plus our dog got a treat on entrance. We came away very happy with the advice and the quality of the goods was amazing.
Mouse’s fave local haunt and such lovely owners
Great pet shop - we shop there for our Labrador boys. It’s a fantastic and friendly local shop.
Great pet shop with a lot of Amazing range!!!The owner is super nice ,friendly and so helpful 😊 …
Great place stocked with cat supplies. We got a litter box, natural litter, cat food, and even a scoop. Great prices too.

This is quite a cute little pet shop. It has quite a reasonable range despite its size.

The woman behind the till has been friendly when I've been in. The products seem good, though often I'm just there to get compostable poo bags for my dog
Very friendly and a great selection
